title: It Feels Like a Perfect Night!
description:
It Feels Like a Perfect Night! A 4 Bedroom, 3 full/2 half bath designer home in Nashville’s Buchanan Arts District, minutes to Broadway, Germantown, Midtown, and top dining. Sleeps 12 (9 beds) with a bonus lounge and wet bar, ideal for groups and celebrations. Enjoy beautiful views from your private rooftop deck. Easy arrivals with garage and driveway parking. Stylish, spacious, and perfectly located for experiencing the best of Music City.

Permit Number:2025106457

The space
Sleeping Arrangements: 
Bedroom 1: 1 King bed + en-suite bath
Bedroom 2: 2 Queen bunk beds + shared Jack & Jill bath
Bedroom 3: 4 Twin bunk beds + shared Jack & Jill bath
Bedroom 4: 2 Queen beds + en-suite bath

Location Highlights: 
7 min to Broadway’s nightlife 
3 min to Germantown’s restaurants & shops 
9 min to Titans Stadium & TopGolf 
15 min to BNA Airport 
19 min to Grand Ole Opry

Guest access
You will receive a unique door code in your check-in instructions. Use this code to unlock the front door to enter the home. The same code also unlocks the interior garage door from inside the garage.

The garage door opener uses a separate code, which will be provided to you as well. The garage accommodates two vehicles, with two additional parking spaces in the driveway.

Guests have full access to the entire home, including three floors and a rooftop seating area.

Other things to note
Need more space? Book our other home on the same property here: "What Would Dolly Do"

https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/1583004488350344182?check_in=2026-02-25&check_out=2026-02-26&guests=1&adults=1&s=67&unique_share_id=7283c2d9-29ff-4c46-83ce-444b5f2bf6e3

There are plenty of restaurants and shopping nearby - Slim & Husky’s Pizza Beeria is one of my personal favorite places to visit, and it's only a short 3 minute walk from the house!
